fact: The Liberia Land Authority signed a three-year MOU with ALLFORLAND and LTMETRIC to develop the Liberia Land Information System, with a pilot in Montserrado and Margibi Counties expected within a few months.

The Liberia Land Authority and Liberia Revenue Authority are using a Real Property Valuation Software and Mobile App for GPS mapping and coding of properties in Nimba County, with over 12,000 properties mapped and data feeding a national cadastre.

fact: The Liberian Investigator reports the SLSL project digitised the historic Monrovia Atlas, scanned 232 archived maps and developed the online CLIMT for customary land administration, as reported at its June 2026 closing seminar.

The LLA signed a three-year memorandum on 16 October 2025 with All for Land and Lee Metrics for developing the Liberia Land Information System, described as a digital platform for land administration.

The Liberia Land Authority's Director of Land Administration says trained surveyors will help densify the national geodetic reference network, laying the foundation for a National Cadastre that is still to be established.

The Embassy of Sweden says its LISA programme with Lantmateriet, running May 2024 to December 2027, includes digitising the Liberia Land Authority's data and data management to streamline property registration.
